verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a Payouts API 'List Payouts' doc title, which suggests payouts can be listed but does not show arrival dates. A generic 'Manage your cash flow' marketing line adds nothing concrete. Nothing in the pack documents speeding up a payout via next-day or instant transfer. missing for 10: documented payout arrival dates/schedule visibility, next-day transfer option, instant transfer option, fees/limits for faster payouts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see when each payout lands and speed it up (next-day or instant) when I need the cash
